## F — Special Driving Challenges
Research index: Special Driving Challenges; the main and continuation fact chunks contain 37 and 34 manually authored, page-anchored statements.
Physical-page coverage: 112 through 120, in handbook order.
VERIFY: ME-SEC11-COUNT — question count; ME-SEC11-PASS — passing standard; ME-SEC11-TIME — time limit.
VERIFY: ME-SEC11-MARKET — market pack; ME-SEC11-TEARDOWN — competitor teardown.
VERIFY: ME-CHALLENGE-ILLUSTRATIVE-NUMBERS — Verify vehicle/environment assumptions and dates for beam distance, winter braking, hydroplaning speeds, flood depths and night/wildlife statistics before exact universal learner use.
VERIFY: ME-CHALLENGE-NIGHT-GAP-STACK — Clarify whether unfamiliar-road night following additions replace or stack with the ordinary night addition before an arithmetic gap answer.
VERIFY: ME-CHALLENGE-WINTER-PROCEDURES — Verify warm-up, brake/clutch/skid recovery, snowbank escape, rocking and idling procedures against current vehicle-specific instructions.
VERIFY: ME-CHALLENGE-WINTER-SURVIVAL — Review blanket no-sleep and engine/heater/window guidance with current cold-exposure and carbon-monoxide survival authority.
VERIFY: ME-CHALLENGE-WILDLIFE-IMPACT — Verify brake release, tail-end aiming and ducking advice for imminent wildlife impact against current restraint and collision safety guidance.
VERIFY: ME-CHALLENGE-CARGO-CURRENTNESS — Verify current cargo overhang, front-seat obstruction/headcount, pickup minor exceptions, dog transport and snow-shedding duties; no current legal signoff is claimed.
Fact-check receipts in the worker scratch preserve all drafted fact ids and source-fidelity verdicts. Those same-model receipts do not substitute for independent QA.
